Create Variant Mapping Data

create_var_df.Rd

Map barcode-level data to variant IDs using a mapping data frame that contains reference and alternate allele sequences.

create_var_df(df, map_df)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing barcode data with a "name" column.

map_df

A data frame with columns "ID", "REF", and "ALT".

Value

A data frame with variant IDs and allele assignments.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  name = c("A", "B", "C"),
  Barcode = c("BC1", "BC2", "BC3"),
  count = c(10, 20, 30)
)
map_df <- data.frame(
  ID = c("var1", "var2", "var3"),
  REF = c("A", "B", "D"),
  ALT = c("E", "F", "C")
)
create_var_df(df, map_df)
#>   variant_id allele Barcode count
#> 1       var1    ref     BC1    10
#> 2       var2    ref     BC2    20
#> 3       var3    alt     BC3    30
